headings.title: Inapplicability of Uniform Veterans' Guardianship Act
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the Uniform Veterans' Guardianship Act does not apply to proceedings where the original petition was filed after December 31, 1980.

headings.title: Standing of Veterans' Administration in proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Specifies standing for the Veterans' Administration when paying benefits and lists circumstances that do not confer interested person status.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.015 covering the non-applicability of the Uniform Veterans' Guardianship Act to petitions filed after 1980 and Veterans' Administration standing.

headings.title: Status of persons adjudicated incompetent prior to September 28, 1983
headings.reviewNote: Deems persons adjudicated incompetent prior to September 28, 1983, totally incapacitated and disabled pending court review and clarifies guardian designations.

headings.title: One-year compliance period for modified reporting requirements
headings.reviewNote: Grants existing guardians and conservators one year after August 28, 2018, to comply with new or different reporting requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 475.016 covering pre-September 28, 1983 incompetency adjudications and the one-year reporting transition after August 28, 2018; source note records original-rolls discrepancy ('chapter 475') in subsection 2.

headings.title: Letters of guardianship and conservatorship for adults
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes letters of guardianship of the person for incapacitated individuals and letters of conservatorship of the estate for disabled individuals.

headings.title: Conservatorship of minor estate not derived from living parent
headings.reviewNote: Mandates letters of conservatorship for a minor's estate not derived from a living parent serving as natural guardian.

headings.title: Conservatorship for entire estate of minor
headings.reviewNote: Permits granting letters of conservatorship for a minor's entire estate if no parent is living or if best interests require.

headings.title: Guardianship of the person of minor
headings.reviewNote: Specifies circumstances where letters of guardianship of the person of a minor may be granted.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 475.030 governing letters of guardianship and conservatorship for adults and minors; source note cites State ex rel. Standefer v. England (1959) on probate jurisdiction over estates.

headings.title: Venue for appointment of guardian or conservator
headings.reviewNote: Establishes county venue based on domicile or significant connection factors for minors and alleged incapacitated or disabled persons.

headings.title: Guardianship county controls when venues differ
headings.reviewNote: Provides that if venue for guardianship and venue for conservatorship lie in different counties, venue shall be in the county of the guardianship.

headings.title: Stay of proceedings commenced in multiple counties
headings.reviewNote: Stays proceedings commenced in more than one county except where first commenced (upon petition filing) until final determination of venue there.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 475.035 establishing county venue rules, precedence of guardianship venue, and stay of duplicate county filings.

headings.title: Priority order for appointing minor guardian or conservator
headings.reviewNote: Mandates appointing, if qualified and fit, the minor's parents (except per section 475.030), the nominee of a minor over fourteen with no living qualified parent, or a testamentary/section 475.046 appointee of the last surviving parent.

headings.title: Judicial adjudication of unfitness after notice and hearing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to adjudge any priority person listed in subsection 1 unfit for guardianship or conservatorship duties after due notice and hearing.

headings.title: Fallback appointment of most suitable willing person
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court, if no appointment is made under subsection 1, to appoint the most suitable willing person whose appointment serves the child's best interests for a stable and permanent placement.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 475.045 governing priority of appointment for guardians and conservators of minors, unfitness adjudications, and fallback best-interest appointments; source cross-reference cites section 473.743 (public administrator).

headings.title: Designation of standby guardian by custodial parent
headings.reviewNote: Permits a custodial parent to designate a standby guardian for a minor or incapacitated person by will or written designation.

headings.title: Petition for appointment of standby guardian upon serious illness
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes filing a petition for appointment of a standby guardian upon the serious illness of the custodial parent.

headings.title: Determination of appointment in best interests of ward
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court to determine standby guardian appointment in accordance with the best interests of the person.

headings.title: Court appointment of standby guardian
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to appoint a standby guardian upon determining the appointment is appropriate.

headings.title: Conditions triggering standby guardian authority
headings.reviewNote: Specifies when standby guardian authority takes effect (upon letters if previously appointed, or upon parental written consent, incapacity adjudication, or death), requiring written court notice within ten days of beginning to act.

headings.title: Post-activation petition requirement for standby guardian
headings.reviewNote: Requires an acting standby guardian to petition for appointment or confirmation within sixty days of commencing duties.

headings.title: Preservation of parental rights and support obligations
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that this section neither deprives a parent of legal rights (including court-ordered visitation) nor relieves a parent of legal obligations or duties (including child support).

headings.title: Application of general guardianship laws to standby guardians
headings.reviewNote: Applies general guardianship laws to standby guardians except as otherwise inconsistent or expressly provided.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 8 editorial headings for 475.046 establishing procedures, conditions, and standards for standby guardians.

headings.title: Order of priority for appointment of guardian or conservator
headings.reviewNote: Lists persons and priorities the court must consider before appointing another eligible person.

headings.title: Restrictions on appointing unrelated third parties
headings.reviewNote: Bars appointing unrelated third parties unless no suitable relative is willing to serve or an exception applies.

headings.title: Effect of respondent's nomination of guardian or conservator
headings.reviewNote: Requires court appointment in accordance with respondent's valid nomination except for good cause shown.

headings.title: Background check and credit report requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires criminal background checks and credit history reports for proposed fiduciaries, with statutory exceptions.

headings.title: Proof of certification by national accrediting organization
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes certified guardians to file proof of certification in lieu of background and credit check requirements.

headings.title: Review of required reports prior to signing appointment order
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits signing an appointment order until required background and credit reports are filed and reviewed by the court.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 6 editorial headings for 475.050 governing order of priority, background checks, and reports for guardians and conservators.

headings.title: General qualifications for guardians and conservators
headings.reviewNote: Specifies qualifications and restrictions for adult persons, corporations, banks, and social service agencies.

headings.title: Consent to act and facility licensing restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing consent to act (except public administrators) and bars specified mental health/social services facility licensees and staff (unless related within fourth degree), full-time judges and court clerks (unless spouse or within third degree), minors, incapacitated/disabled persons, habitual drunkards, and persons revoked within two years.

headings.title: Effective appointment upon issuance of letters and residency
headings.reviewNote: States that guardianship or conservatorship commences upon issuance of letters and addresses nonresident appointees.

headings.title: Applicability of statutes to nonresident fiduciaries
headings.reviewNote: Applies statutory provisions regarding process agents and nonresident administration to nonresident guardians and conservators.

headings.title: Petition to remove social service agency as guardian
headings.reviewNote: Permits eligible relatives under section 475.050.1(3) to petition to remove a social service agency guardian in favor of a qualified best-interest petitioner without requiring proof of section 475.110 misfeasance.

headings.title: Limitation on social service agency authority over life support
headings.reviewNote: Restricts social service agencies acting as guardians from withholding or withdrawing artificial nutrition or hydration without statutory compliance.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 475.055 setting guardian/conservator qualifications, disqualifications, residency rules, and social service agency limits; source note cites Roots v. Reid (1977) on relative preference.

headings.title: Contents of petition for appointment of guardian of minor
headings.reviewNote: Specifies information, addresses, and estate details required in a petition for guardianship of a minor.

headings.title: Contents of petition for guardian of incapacitated person
headings.reviewNote: Detailed requirements for a petition for appointment of a guardian or limited guardian of an adult incapacitated person.

headings.title: Requirements for emergency guardianship petition
headings.reviewNote: Requires an emergency guardian petition to include subsection 1 requirements and request appointment per subsection 15 of section 475.075.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 475.060 detailing petition requirements for minor, incapacitated adult, and emergency guardianships; source note cites In re Dugan (1957) on jurisdictional petition allegations.

headings.title: Petition for appointment of conservator of the estate
headings.reviewNote: Sets forth required allegations and incapacity grounds for petitions seeking appointment of a conservator.

headings.title: Combination of conservatorship and guardianship petitions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes combining a petition for conservator of the estate with a petition for guardian of the person.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.061 governing petitions for conservatorship and consolidation with guardianship petitions.

headings.title: Procedures for contested or nonconsensual conservatorship petition
headings.reviewNote: Applies notice, counsel appointment, hearing, and adjudication procedures of section 475.075 to nonconsensual petitions.

headings.title: Appointment of counsel upon voluntary or consented petition
headings.reviewNote: Directs immediate appointment of an attorney to advise the respondent when a conservatorship petition is consensual.

headings.title: Appointment of conservator without notice or hearing
headings.reviewNote: Permits summary appointment of respondent's choice of conservator if respondent understands purpose and desires appointment.

headings.title: Notice to co-depositors and co-tenants
headings.reviewNote: Mandates notice to co-depositors and co-tenants prior to court action on a conservatorship petition.

headings.title: Service by publication for disappeared or detained respondent
headings.reviewNote: Directs service by publication under civil rules when a disappeared or detained person's whereabouts are unknown.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 5 editorial headings for 475.062 covering involuntary and voluntary conservatorship petitions and service requirements.

headings.title: Persons entitled to notice of minor guardianship petition
headings.reviewNote: Lists family members, nominees, and agencies entitled to service of notice on a petition for minor guardianship.

headings.title: Personal service requirements for minors over fourteen
headings.reviewNote: Requires personal service on minors over fourteen years of age if obtainable.

headings.title: Service exception for school enrollment or medical coverage
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes dispensing with service on absent parents when petition is solely for school enrollment or health insurance.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 3 editorial headings for 475.070 specifying notice and service rules for minor guardianship petitions.

headings.title: Court setting of petition for hearing upon good cause
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court to promptly set a non-minority guardianship or conservatorship petition for hearing upon good cause.

headings.title: Personal service on respondent and notice to relatives
headings.reviewNote: Requires personal service of petition and rights on respondent and specifies notice to family members and fiduciaries.

headings.title: Notice when public administrator is nominated
headings.reviewNote: Requires advance notice to public administrator before appointment hearing and specifies appearance procedure.

headings.title: Appointment of counsel for respondent
headings.reviewNote: Requires immediate appointment of counsel upon filing a subsection 1, section 475.092, or section 475.123 petition, with counsel visiting the respondent at least twenty-four hours before hearing unless waived for good cause.

headings.title: Access of appointed counsel to medical and financial records
headings.reviewNote: Grants appointed counsel access to medical and financial records with provider immunity, taxes fees as costs, requires a hearing for withdrawal upon private counsel entry, bars serving as GAL/CAL until judgment and appeal conclude, and bars petitioner nomination of counsel.

headings.title: Court-ordered medical or psychological examination
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court-ordered examination by a physician, licensed psychologist, or experienced professional, who must first explain in simple language the examination's purpose, right to remain silent, and use of statements at hearing.

headings.title: Submission and admissibility of evaluation report
headings.reviewNote: Requires a written examiner report submitted to the court and counsel, precludes objecting based on the court's ultimate decision role, permits a limited admissibility hearing on other objections, and allows taxing examiner fees as costs.

headings.title: Compelled professional testimony upon prima facie proof
headings.reviewNote: Makes physicians, licensed psychologists, and appropriate professionals competent and compellable to testify upon prima facie proof despite testimonial privileges, while barring use of privileged evidence or reports in other civil or criminal proceedings without consent.

headings.title: Burden of proof on petitioner by clear and convincing evidence
headings.reviewNote: Establishes petitioner's burden of proving incapacity or disability by clear and convincing evidence.

headings.title: Statutory rights of respondent during proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Details specific rights guaranteed to the respondent including presence, jury trial, cross-examination, and closed hearing.

headings.title: Dismissal upon finding of capacity or ability
headings.reviewNote: Requires dismissal of petition if respondent possesses capacity or ability to manage essential personal or financial affairs.

headings.title: Application of least restrictive alternative standard
headings.reviewNote: Mandates imposition of least restrictive environment and authority when incapacity or disability is found.

headings.title: Consideration of supported decision-making and services
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court to examine whether needs can be met through family, community services, or supported decision-making.

headings.title: Required findings of fact in adjudication order
headings.reviewNote: Specifies detailed factual findings regarding incapacity, disability, and suitability required in the court order.

headings.title: Emergency guardianship and conservatorship procedures
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointing an emergency guardian or conservator ad litem for up to ninety days (with ninety-day extensions after hearing) upon hearing within five business days of filing, bars use as an alternative to chapter 632 involuntary detention, and permits termination if no permanent petition is filed within ninety days.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 475.075 governing incapacity/disability hearings, service, counsel, examinations, compelled testimony, respondent rights, least restrictive alternatives, findings, and emergency appointments; source notes cite In re Link (1986) on record waivers and Matter of Korman (1996) on jury verdicts.

headings.title: Legal effect of partial incapacity or partial disability adjudication
headings.reviewNote: Provides that partial adjudication imposes only those legal disabilities expressly specified in the court order.

headings.title: Legal effect of full incapacity or disability adjudication
headings.reviewNote: Imposes all legal disabilities provided by law upon full adjudication except as specified in the order or chapter, while barring legal disabilities on a person whose conservator was appointed due to disappearance, detention, or confinement.

headings.title: Presumption of incompetence or competence and partial determinations
headings.reviewNote: Presumes incapacitated or disabled persons incompetent and partially incapacitated or disabled persons competent, authorizing the court after hearing to determine competence for some purposes and incompetence for others.

headings.title: Express retention of voting, driving, and marriage rights
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to expressly order that a ward or protectee retains the right to vote even if totally incapacitated, may drive if passing the driving test, or retains the right to marry.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 editorial headings for 475.078 specifying legal effects of partial and total incapacity or disability adjudications.

headings.title: Order appointing guardian of the person
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointing a guardian of the person upon clear and convincing proof of incapacity and a finding that identified needs cannot be met by a less restrictive alternative.

headings.title: Order appointing conservator of the estate
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointing a conservator of the estate for a minor or disabled person upon finding identified needs cannot be met by a less restrictive alternative.

headings.title: Hearing requirement before appointing public administrator
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits appointing the public administrator without prior section 475.075.3 notice and opportunity to participate (including cross-examination and evidence), unless waived by the public administrator.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 3 editorial headings for 475.079 governing court orders appointing guardians, conservators, and public administrators.

headings.title: Appointment and scope of limited guardian
headings.reviewNote: Requires appointing a limited guardian when partial incapacity is found and needs cannot be met by a less restrictive alternative, specifying tailored powers, legal disabilities, and maximum self-reliance.

headings.title: Appointment and scope of limited conservator
headings.reviewNote: Requires appointing a limited conservator when partial disability is found and needs cannot be met by a less restrictive alternative, specifying tailored property powers commensurate with ability.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.080 governing appointment and orders for limited guardians and limited conservators.

headings.title: Appointment of limited conservator for disappeared or detained person
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointing a limited conservator for a person disappeared, forcibly detained, or unable to return from abroad for one month or more, administered on a presumption of life with powers limited to dependent support and preventing estate loss.

headings.title: Immediate notice to court upon return or discovery of protectee
headings.reviewNote: Requires immediate notice to the court if the protectee is found, released, or returns to the United States, and directs the court to terminate the conservatorship and require final settlement.

headings.title: Quarterly reporting requirement on continued disappearance or detention
headings.reviewNote: Mandates quarterly status reports to the court regarding the continued disappearance or detention of the protectee.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 3 editorial headings for 475.081 covering appointment, reporting, and termination for disappeared or detained persons.

headings.title: Court duty to conduct annual status review
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court to review the status of every adult ward and protectee annually to assess need for continued supervision.

headings.title: Annual personal status report by guardian
headings.reviewNote: Requires the guardian to file an annual report regarding the ward's personal status, living condition, and future care plans.

headings.title: Order for mental status evaluation and medical records
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes ordering a mental status evaluation, requiring medical or custodial records, and contacting the department of health and senior services or other agencies to investigate guardian conduct.

headings.title: Appointment of counsel upon indication of restored capacity
headings.reviewNote: Directs appointment of an attorney to file a restoration petition if review indicates incapacity or disability has ceased.

headings.title: Sanctions for guardian or conservator failure to discharge duties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes ordering a hearing (with appointed counsel for an unrepresented ward/protectee) and entering appropriate orders including removal, successor appointment, or termination if duties are not discharged, giving due consideration to fiduciary discretion.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 5 editorial headings for 475.082 governing annual status reviews, guardian reports, mental evaluations, and discharge proceedings.

headings.title: Events terminating authority of guardian or conservator
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates statutory events terminating fiduciary authority, including age of majority, restoration, death, or court order.

headings.title: Court order terminating guardianship or conservatorship
headings.reviewNote: Specifies grounds for judicial termination including estate exhaustion, lack of necessity, or parental suitability.

headings.title: Conservator authority to wind up administration
headings.reviewNote: Preserves conservator's authority following termination to perform acts necessary to conclude administration.

headings.title: Petition for restoration, power reduction, or rights restoration
headings.reviewNote: Permits restoration or power-reduction petitions (including by informal letter, with contempt for interference, summary dismissal if frivolous) and requires a hearing on the court's own motion when warranted.

headings.title: Summary order upon joint restoration or modification petition
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes summary approval of restoration or authority modification upon joint petition by fiduciary and ward or protectee.

headings.title: Hearing and counsel requirements on contested modification petition
headings.reviewNote: Requires a section 475.075 hearing with appointed counsel if unrepresented on non-joint or hearing-required petitions, placing a preponderance-of-the-evidence burden on the petitioner and limiting filings to once every one hundred eighty days.

headings.title: Fiduciary petition to increase powers or restrict rights
headings.reviewNote: Governs petitions by guardians or conservators seeking increased authority or further limitation of protectee rights.

headings.title: Professional evaluation reports on termination or modification
headings.reviewNote: Permits the court to require evaluation reports by qualified professionals before deciding termination or modification.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 8 editorial headings for 475.083 governing statutory and court-ordered termination, restoration, and power modification.

headings.title: Allocation and liability for costs of proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Allocates costs of incapacity or disability proceedings among the estate, county, or petitioner based on hearing outcome.

headings.title: Waiver of filing fees for indigent respondents
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court to accept petitions involving indigent respondents without prepayment of filing fees and tax costs later.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.085 governing liability for court costs and indigent respondent procedures.

headings.title: Protective arrangements without appointing conservator
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to approve single transactions or protective care arrangements without appointing a conservator.

headings.title: Authorization of contracts and establishment of inter vivos trusts
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the court to authorize contracts and establish qualifying inter vivos or Medicaid payback trusts for disabled persons.

headings.title: Considerations and appointment of special conservator
headings.reviewNote: Requires consideration of creditor and dependent interests and permits appointment of a special conservator to complete transactions.

headings.title: Trustee liability limitations for pre-1999 judicial trusts
headings.reviewNote: Protects trustees of court-approved trusts created before August 28, 1999, from liability regarding Medicaid reimbursements.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 editorial headings for 475.092 governing protective arrangements, single transactions, special conservators, and trust liabilities.

headings.title: Court authorization of Missouri family trust accounts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes establishment of family trust accounts for protectees qualifying as life beneficiaries.

headings.title: Charitable remainder contribution deemed in protectee best interest
headings.reviewNote: Confirms that principal distribution up to twenty-five percent to charitable trust is consistent with protectee's best interests.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.093 governing establishment of Missouri family trust accounts for protectees.

headings.title: Court-authorized powers to make gifts and estate transactions
headings.reviewNote: Lists specific conservator actions requiring notice and prior court approval, including gifts, conveyances, and contract releases.

headings.title: Judicial standards and criteria for approving conservator transactions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies factors the court must consider, emphasizing the protectee's probable decision and estate financial realities.

headings.title: Restriction on revoking or amending durable power of attorney
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits a conservator from amending or revoking the protectee's durable power of attorney without express court authorization.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 3 editorial headings for 475.094 governing authorized exercise of powers by conservators with court approval.

headings.title: Appointment of conservator of in-state estate for nonresident
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes probate court to appoint a conservator for Missouri estate assets owned by a nonresident minor or disabled person.

headings.title: Powers, duties, and restrictions of nonresident protectee conservator
headings.reviewNote: Subject conservators of nonresident protectees to the same statutory powers, duties, and restrictions as resident conservators.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.095 governing appointment and authority of conservators for nonresident protectees.

headings.title: Immediate appointment of guardian or conservator ad litem
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointing a guardian or conservator ad litem (with or without notice, up to six months or pending hearing) when a fiduciary is not effectively performing duties and welfare requires immediate action, suspending permanent authority.

headings.title: Appointment of ad litem fiduciary for conflict of interest
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appointing a guardian or conservator ad litem to represent the ward or protectee in a proceeding upon petition or court finding of a possible conflict of interest with the guardian or conservator.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 475.097 governing emergency guardian/conservator ad litem appointments for ineffective performance and conflict-of-interest appointments; source note cites Cordes v. Caldwell (1987) barring interlocutory appeal.

headings.title: Issuance of letters under seal and evidentiary effect
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuing letters under court seal after bond approval specifying guardianship, limited, standby, or conservatorship status, with originals or certified copies serving as prima facie evidence.

headings.title: Statutory form for minor guardianship and conservatorship letters
headings.reviewNote: Sets forth the optional statutory form for letters of (standby) guardianship (and conservatorship) of a minor.

headings.title: Statutory form for incapacitated or disabled person letters
headings.reviewNote: Sets forth the optional statutory form for letters of (standby) guardianship of an incapacitated person (and conservatorship of a disabled person).

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 475.105 governing issuance of letters under court seal and statutory forms for minor and adult incapacitated/disabled letters.

headings.title: Grounds for removal of guardian or conservator
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes removing a minor's guardian on petition of a ward aged fourteen or older in the ward's best interests, mandates removal of a spouse upon marriage dissolution, and incorporates section 473.140 removal grounds.

headings.title: Former spouse petition to remain or be reappointed
headings.reviewNote: Permits a spouse whose marriage to the ward was dissolved to petition the court under section 475.115 to remain as or be reappointed guardian or conservator.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.110 governing grounds for removal of guardians and conservators and marriage dissolution impacts.

headings.title: Appointment of successor guardian or conservator
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the court to appoint a successor guardian or conservator upon vacancy and exercise authority over predecessor bonds.

headings.title: Inter-county case transfer by public administrator
headings.reviewNote: Establishes procedures for transferring public administrator guardianship or conservatorship cases to another consenting county.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.115 governing successor fiduciary appointments and public administrator inter-county transfers.

headings.title: Custody, education, and maintenance duties for minor ward
headings.reviewNote: Grants guardian of a minor custody and control and requires provision for education, support, and maintenance.

headings.title: Best interest standard and powers of limited guardian
headings.reviewNote: Directs guardian to act in adult ward's best interest and confines limited guardian authority to court-enumerated powers.

headings.title: General authority, health decisions, and least restrictive setting
headings.reviewNote: Specifies decision-making authority over adult care, education, and health while promoting ward independence in least restrictive settings.

headings.title: No obligation to use personal resources and county relief
headings.reviewNote: Relieves guardian of personal financial obligation for ward and authorizes county commission relief when estate is inadequate.

headings.title: Court order required for long-term facility admission
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits guardian from placing ward in mental health or intellectual disability facility for over thirty days without court order.

headings.title: Designation of authorized agency officer to act for ward
headings.reviewNote: Restricts authority to act on behalf of agency ward to director, chief administrative officer, or designee.

headings.title: Notice to court of changes in agency professional personnel
headings.reviewNote: Requires social service agency to notify the court within fifteen days of changing assigned primary professional staff.

headings.title: Prohibition on social service agency providing outside services
headings.reviewNote: Bars a social service agency serving as guardian from providing other services to the ward.

headings.title: Preneed funeral contracts and burial arrangements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes executing preneed funeral contracts or irrevocable life insurance (including cremation) absent written ward direction, preserves section 194.119 next-of-kin sepulcher rights, permits guardian consent if unexercised within ten days of death, and relieves personal financial liability.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 9 editorial headings for 475.120 governing powers, duties, resource obligations, agency limits, and preneed arrangements of guardians.

headings.title: Application and physician statement for facility admission
headings.reviewNote: Requires verified application and physician statement detailing diagnosis and treatment plan to admit ward to mental health facility.

headings.title: Order authorizing inpatient admission without further evidence
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court order for inpatient admission when application establishes necessity without requiring additional evidence.

headings.title: Appointment of counsel and hearing on admission application
headings.reviewNote: Empowers court to appoint counsel for ward and requires hearing upon attorney request.

headings.title: Consolidation with initial incapacity adjudication proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes combining facility admission proceedings with adjudication proceedings under section 475.075.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 editorial headings for 475.121 governing court procedures and applications for mental health facility admissions.

headings.title: Guardian consent requirement for medical and surgical procedures
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits performing medical or surgical procedures on a ward without obtaining consent from guardian of the person.

headings.title: Emergency medical exception for life-threatening conditions
headings.reviewNote: Permits emergency medical or surgical treatment without prior consent when ward's life is threatened and necessity is documented.

headings.title: Court authorization of emergency treatment on petition
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to grant consent for necessary medical or surgical care when person's life is threatened and consent cannot be had.

headings.title: Emergency hearing at medical facility and oral notice
headings.reviewNote: Allows emergency medical hearings to occur at the treatment facility with practicable expedited notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 editorial headings for 475.123 governing consent and emergency authorizations for medical and surgical procedures.

headings.title: Court orders for support, education, and maintenance of protectee
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court orders directing estate proceeds to be paid on periodic schedules for care, habilitation, and family maintenance.

headings.title: Standard of living and financial factors in setting allowance
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court to consider prior standard of living, estate assets, available income, and expenses when setting support amounts.

headings.title: Payment of appropriations and court authorization to borrow money
headings.reviewNote: Governs payment of claims and authorizes conservator borrowing upon court finding of necessity and anticipated estate funds.

headings.title: Duty to enforce third-party support obligations
headings.reviewNote: Requires court, guardian, and conservator to consider and enforce legal or contractual support duties owed by spouses, parents, or programs.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 editorial headings for 475.125 governing estate allowances, standard of living considerations, borrowing, and third-party support.

headings.title: General duties and prudent person management standard
headings.reviewNote: Directs the conservator to protect, preserve, manage, and account for the estate using ordinarily prudent person care (and any represented special skills) while acting in the protectee's interest and avoiding conflicts.

headings.title: Possession of real and personal property and title status
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes conservator to take possession of property, rents, and profits, leaving protectee title unvested in conservator.

headings.title: Reasonable efforts to ascertain assets, needs, and management plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires reasonable efforts to ascertain income, assets, liabilities, needs, and preferences, coordinate with the guardian and close contacts, prepare a management plan, and oversee protectee-controlled assets.

headings.title: Court authority to enjoin interference with estate possession
headings.reviewNote: Confirms full court authority under civil procedure rules to enjoin any person from interfering with the conservator's possession of protectee assets, including payable benefits.

headings.title: Duty to prosecute, defend, collect debts, and pay claims
headings.reviewNote: Requires the conservator to prosecute and defend actions, collect debts, give discharges, and adjust, settle, and pay claims from the estate except as provided in sections 507.150 and 507.188.

headings.title: Sixteen estate powers exercisable without court approval
headings.reviewNote: Lists sixteen powers exercisable without court authorization including settling claims or selling/exchanging chattels up to five thousand dollars, insuring and repairing property, one-year leases and necessaries contracts, voting stock, banking, taxes, litigation, and section 475.190 investments.

headings.title: Surcharge for breach and protection of good-faith third parties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes surcharging a conservator for estate losses from breaching subsection 1 duties while allowing good-faith third parties without notice of breach to enforce and retain transaction benefits.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 475.130 governing conservator fiduciary standards, estate possession, management efforts, injunctions against interference, litigation/claims, powers without court order, and surcharges; source cross-reference cites section 409.950.

headings.title: Conservator individual liability on contracts
headings.reviewNote: Immunizes conservator from personal contract liability unless contract otherwise provides or fiduciary capacity is undisclosed.

headings.title: Individual liability of conservator for property ownership and torts
headings.reviewNote: Imposes individual liability on conservator for torts or property control obligations only when personally at fault.

headings.title: Claims against estate based on conservator administration
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes asserting claims against conservatorship estate directly for administrative contracts and fiduciarily incurred torts.

headings.title: Internal liability proceedings between estate and conservator
headings.reviewNote: Permits questions of liability between estate and conservator to be determined in accounting, surcharge, or indemnity actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 editorial headings for 475.132 governing personal and fiduciary liabilities of conservators on contracts and torts.

headings.title: Clerk duty to publish notice of letters of conservatorship
headings.reviewNote: Directs court clerk to publish notice of letters of conservatorship for non-minor disabled protectees.

headings.title: Discretion of court to waive or defer publication
headings.reviewNote: Permits the probate court to waive publication of notice or defer publication until a later date or order.

headings.title: Specification of limited conservator in notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires publication notice to expressly specify when appointment is for a limited conservator.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 3 editorial headings for 475.140 governing publication of notice of conservator appointment.

headings.title: Investment of liquid assets under prudent investor standard
headings.reviewNote: Requires investing surplus liquid assets on or after August 28, 2009 under the Missouri prudent investor act (sections 469.900 to 469.913), with safe harbors for U.S. obligations and insured bank/credit union deposits and written fiduciary acknowledgment for delegated agents.

headings.title: Annual settlement report on money disposition and securities
headings.reviewNote: Requires reporting money disposition and detailed securities/real estate descriptions at each annual settlement (or diligent-effort reasons if uninvested), with court examination, protective orders, and bond liability for noncompliance.

headings.title: Bond liability and removal for failure or false investment report
headings.reviewNote: Holds the conservator and sureties liable on bond for losses from neglecting, refusing, or falsifying investment reports, and authorizes discretionary removal by the court.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 3 editorial headings for 475.190 governing investment of liquid assets, annual reporting, and liability for noncompliance.

headings.title: Purposes for selling, mortgaging, or leasing estate property
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes sale, mortgage, pledge, or lease of protectee property for support, maintenance, debts, or investment.

headings.title: Petition by conservator for property disposition
headings.reviewNote: Requires verified petition describing estate condition and permits court order upon full examination of necessity.

headings.title: Petition by creditor or interested person to compel sale
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes creditors or interested persons to file petition to compel disposition upon twenty days' notice to conservator.

headings.title: Court-ordered hearing on property disposition upon settlement deficiency
headings.reviewNote: Empowers court to order hearing on property sale or mortgage when settlement reveals inadequate cash to pay obligations.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 editorial headings for 475.200 governing sales, mortgages, leases, and exchanges of protectee property.

headings.title: Filing notice of outside legal proceedings as claim
headings.reviewNote: Deems filing notice or judgment of an outside court proceeding in probate court to constitute claim filing.

headings.title: Inapplicability of probate non-claim statute to disabled estates
headings.reviewNote: Exempts estates of disabled persons from the decedent probate non-claim statute limitations of section 473.360.

headings.title: Prospective application to disability adjudications after August 28, 1993
headings.reviewNote: Applies section provisions to estates of disabled persons adjudicated on or after August 28, 1993.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 3 editorial headings for 475.210 governing notices of outside legal proceedings and non-claim statute inapplicability.

headings.title: Payment of claims according to statutory class priority
headings.reviewNote: Directs conservator to pay claims strictly according to priority classes and make proportionate payments within depleted classes.

headings.title: Discretionary notice to creditors to file claims
headings.reviewNote: Empowers court to order published and mailed notice barring unfiled claims from participating in current distributions.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.213 governing claim priority payments and court-ordered notices to creditors.

headings.title: Procedures for sales of real estate of protectees
headings.reviewNote: Applies decedent estate real property sales procedures to sales of protectee real property.

headings.title: Ten-day notice requirement to protectee on property sales
headings.reviewNote: Requires ten days' prior notice to the protectee for hearings on selling real or tangible personal property unless waived for cause, while denying notice for hearings on selling intangible personal property.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.230 governing procedures for sales of real estate and protectee notice rights.

headings.title: Execution, contents, and recitals of conservator deeds
headings.reviewNote: Directs conservator to execute deed upon payment, specify court orders and sale terms, and establishes prima facie evidentiary recitals.

headings.title: Execution of deed by successor conservator or county sheriff
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes successor conservator or county sheriff to complete sale or execute deed upon predecessor's death or removal.

headings.title: Acknowledgment, recording, and evidentiary admissibility of deeds
headings.reviewNote: Provides that acknowledged conservator deeds shall be recorded and admitted into evidence in state courts without further proof.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 3 editorial headings for 475.245 governing conservator deeds, execution by sheriff, and evidentiary effect.

headings.title: Representation of protectee in actions by conservator
headings.reviewNote: Requires actions charging or benefiting the estate to be prosecuted by or against the conservator as legal representative.

headings.title: Dual capacity suits, non-dismissal, and substitution of parties
headings.reviewNote: Permits dual capacity actions, provides that naming protectee is not ground for dismissal, and governs party substitutions.

headings.title: Immunity of protectee assets from garnishment, attachment, and execution
headings.reviewNote: Exempts protectee assets from garnishment or execution and directs judgment enforcement following decedent estate procedures.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 3 editorial headings for 475.260 governing actions by and against conservators, personal liability, and garnishment exemption.

headings.title: Annual settlement filing requirement and timing
headings.reviewNote: Directs every conservator to file an annual settlement within sixty days following the anniversary of appointment.

headings.title: Conformity of annual settlement to decedent estate standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires conservator settlements to conform to accounting and verification rules for decedent estates under section 473.543.

headings.title: Simplified annual reporting for indigent or restricted estates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to permit simplified receipts and disbursements reporting for indigent, federal fiduciary, or restricted accounts.

headings.title: Required personal status and estate administration disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Mandates non-public conservators report protectee and conservator addresses, services, actions, need opinions, and compensation.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 editorial headings for 475.270 governing annual settlements, simplified reporting, and required protectee status disclosures.

headings.title: Exhibition and verification of securities at annual settlement
headings.reviewNote: Requires conservator to exhibit all investment securities to bank officer, surety representative, or court official for verification.

headings.title: Pooled account criteria and public administrator CPA examination
headings.reviewNote: Defines pooled accounts with five custodial/recordkeeping criteria, requires annual independent CPA examination and affidavit for public administrator pooled accounts at county expense, and waives subsection 1 depository verification when the report is provided.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.275 governing verification of securities and restrictions on fiduciary pooled accounts.

headings.title: Discretionary order waiving annual settlements for indigent estates
headings.reviewNote: Permits the court to waive annual settlements when protectee assets are managed by another fiduciary or estate is under indigent threshold.

headings.title: Order waiving settlement for cash placed in restricted custody
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes waiving annual settlements when protectee assets consist solely of cash or equivalents placed in restricted depositary custody.

headings.title: Contents and termination of settlement waiver orders
headings.reviewNote: Requires waiver orders to specify termination events, permits exempting the estate from court costs and administration expenses while in effect, and allows directing state or requesting federal direct payment of benefits to a custodial facility.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 3 editorial headings for 475.276 governing court orders waiving annual settlements and restricted account procedures.

headings.title: Maintenance of conservator settlement docket
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court clerk to maintain a docket listing conservators and the scheduled dates for annual settlements.

headings.title: Advance notice to conservators of required settlement date
headings.reviewNote: Requires clerk to mail notice to conservators at least thirty days before annual settlements are due.

headings.title: Applicability of decedent estate enforcement rules to conservators
headings.reviewNote: Applies decedent estate settlement enforcement statutes and citation procedures to delinquent conservators.

headings.title: Maintenance of annual guardian personal status report docket
headings.reviewNote: Requires clerk to maintain a docket of guardians and provide thirty days' advance notice for annual personal status reports.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 editorial headings for 475.280 governing court dockets, advance filing notice, and enforcement against delinquent fiduciaries.

headings.title: Filing of final settlement within ninety days of termination
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing final settlement within ninety days after termination (except under section 475.320 no-administration orders) and delivering account copy and written notice at least twenty days before the settlement date.

headings.title: Notice of final settlement by publication
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes service of final settlement notice by newspaper publication when personal delivery to protectee cannot be made.

headings.title: Court examination, correction of errors, and final settlement
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court, upon proof of notice, waiver, or publication, to examine accounts, correct errors, and make final settlement, or continue the settlement for good cause.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 3 editorial headings for 475.290 governing final settlements, notice delivery, and court approval of discharge.

headings.title: Settlement by deceased conservator's personal representative or successor
headings.reviewNote: Requires personal representative of deceased conservator to make settlement with successor, or allows court to waive representative.

headings.title: Payment of administration costs when letters issued solely for settlement
headings.reviewNote: Allocates costs and expenses to protectee estate when letters in deceased conservator's estate issue solely to make settlement.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.295 governing settlement and administration upon the death of a conservator.

headings.title: Discretionary order dispensing with letters of administration upon protectee death
headings.reviewNote: Permits court to order no administration, authorizing conservator to pay burial costs, taxes, and debts and distribute to heirs.

headings.title: Requirement for letters of administration when debts or will exist
headings.reviewNote: Mandates granting letters testamentary or administration when deceased protectee left outside debts or a valid will.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 475.320 governing estate administration and distribution upon a protectee's death; source notes cite State v. Hollenbeck (1965) construing 'debts' as claims and confirming court discretion.

headings.title: Dispensing with conservatorship for minor estate under ten thousand dollars
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to dispense with conservatorship for minor estates up to ten thousand dollars by deposit, custodian delivery, or parent receipt.

headings.title: Dispensing with conservatorship for disabled adult estate under ten thousand dollars
headings.reviewNote: Permits court to dispense with conservator for disabled adult estate up to ten thousand dollars by deposit or designated person custody.

headings.title: Discharge of existing conservator upon reduction to ten thousand dollars
headings.reviewNote: Empowers court to discharge acting conservator and dispose of assets under small estate rules when value is under ten thousand dollars.

headings.title: Release and discharge of paying entities making small estate distributions
headings.reviewNote: Discharges persons, institutions, and officers transferring property pursuant to small estate orders to same extent as paying conservator.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 editorial headings for 475.330 governing small estate conservatorship dispensing procedures for minors and disabled adults.

headings.title: Service of process upon foreign guardian or conservator
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes service on foreign fiduciaries by registered, certified, or ordinary mail, or under general state service laws.

headings.title: Thirty-day minimum response period following service
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees foreign guardian or conservator at least thirty days to appear or respond following service.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.338 governing service of process and response periods for foreign guardians and conservators.

headings.title: Court authorization for nonresident conservator to sell or mortgage land
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes probate court to permit nonresident guardian or conservator to mortgage, extend, or sell protectee's Missouri real property.

headings.title: Bond and authentication requirements prior to payment or sale order
headings.reviewNote: Requires nonresident fiduciary to produce authenticated proof of appointment and sufficient bond in home state prior to court order.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.340 governing mortgage or sale of Missouri real estate by nonresident conservators.

headings.title: Voidability of self-interested transactions by conservator and exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that transactions entered into for conservator's personal gain are voidable unless court-approved or falling under statutory exceptions.

headings.title: Absolute prohibition on personal gain transactions by public administrator
headings.reviewNote: Bars public administrator serving as conservator from entering into any transaction for personal gain.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.341 governing voidable self-interested transactions and public administrator conflict bans.

headings.title: Guardian personal finances not obligated for ward support
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that guardian is not required to use personal funds for ward and authorizes application to county commission when funds fail.

headings.title: Court order required for ward admission to mental health facility
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits guardian from admitting ward to mental health or intellectual disability facility for over thirty days without court order.

headings.title: Authority of designated agency officer to act on behalf of ward
headings.reviewNote: Restricts legal authority to act for agency ward to director, chief administrative officer, or designated representative.

headings.title: Fifteen-day notice requirement for agency personnel changes
headings.reviewNote: Directs social service agency to notify the court within fifteen days of any change in primary responsible guardianship personnel.

headings.title: Prohibition on social service agency providing other ward services
headings.reviewNote: Bars a social service agency serving as guardian from providing other services to the ward.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 5 editorial headings for 475.343 governing resource duties, mental health facility admissions, and social service agency fiduciaries.

headings.title: Temporary detention under chapter 632 or 633 pending hearing
headings.reviewNote: Permits detaining a respondent who presents a likelihood of serious physical harm due to a mental disorder (under chapter 632) or intellectual/developmental disability (under chapter 633) pending an adjudication hearing.

headings.title: Statutory definitions incorporating chapters 630 and 632
headings.reviewNote: Defines mental disorder, intellectual disability, and developmental disability by reference to chapter 630, and likelihood of serious physical harm by reference to chapter 632.

headings.title: Chapter 632 procedure for temporary emergency detention orders
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that the procedure for obtaining a temporary emergency detention order is as prescribed by chapter 632 for prehearing detention of mentally disordered persons.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 475.355 governing temporary emergency detention under chapters 632 and 633, statutory definitions, and chapter 632 prehearing detention procedures.

headings.title: Eight enumerated personal rights of every ward
headings.reviewNote: Grants every ward, notwithstanding section 475.078, eight rights including a best-interest accessible guardian, private communication (limitable for good cause), guardianship legal actions, least restrictive assistance, earliest restoration, rights information, and health care decision participation.

headings.title: Seven rights an adult ward may petition court to grant
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes an adult ward to petition the court for the right to marry or seek dissolution, make or ratify contracts, consent to medical treatment, establish residence, change domicile, litigate non-guardianship actions, or drive upon passing the test.

headings.title: Revocation of prior health care durable power of attorney
headings.reviewNote: Provides that appointment of a guardian revokes the powers of a previously appointed durable power of attorney for health care agent unless the court orders otherwise.

headings.title: Preservation of testamentary capacity and right to execute will
headings.reviewNote: Affirms that guardianship adjudication does not automatically preclude ward from executing a will if testamentary capacity exists.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 475.361 enumerating eight mandatory ward rights, seven petitionable adult-ward rights, revocation of prior health-care powers of attorney, and preservation of testamentary capacity.

headings.title: Application to county commission for indigent ward appropriation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes guardian or conservator to petition county commission for support appropriation when ward estate is exhausted.

headings.title: Required verified accounting and debt inventory with petition
headings.reviewNote: Mandates verified petition accompanied by full account of administration, estate inventory, and list of outstanding debts.

headings.title: County commission order and warrant on county treasury
headings.reviewNote: Empowers county commission to order reasonable appropriation and issue warrant on county treasury for ward maintenance.

headings.title: One-year limit on allowances and annual probate settlement prerequisite
headings.reviewNote: Restricts county allowances to one-year periods and prohibits grants without annual accounting and settlement in probate court.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 editorial headings for 475.370 governing county commission appropriations for indigent wards and annual settlement rules.

headings.title: Veterans Administration as party in interest in proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Designates Veterans Administration as party in interest in proceedings involving wards receiving federal veterans benefits.

headings.title: Fifteen days' advance notice of hearing to Veterans Administration
headings.reviewNote: Requires at least fifteen days' written notice of hearing by mail to the regional Veterans Administration office.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.385 designating Veterans Administration as party in interest and requiring advance notice.

headings.title: Persons entitled to file petition for appointment of guardian
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes relatives, friends, or any state resident to file petition if authorized persons fail to act within thirty days.

headings.title: Required ward identifying information and veterans benefit details
headings.reviewNote: Requires petition to set forth ward age, residence, nearest relative, and amounts of due and anticipated veterans benefits.

headings.title: Proposed guardian details, custodian information, and bank appointments
headings.reviewNote: Directs disclosure of custodian and nominee details and authorizes court appointment of qualified individuals or banks in ward's best interest.

headings.title: Requirement of Veterans Administration rating of incompetency
headings.reviewNote: Mandates showing that alleged incompetent ward has been rated incompetent on official examination by Veterans Administration.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 editorial headings for 475.400 governing petition contents and standing for Veterans Administration guardianships.

headings.title: Approval and amount of guardian bond for veterans' benefits
headings.reviewNote: Requires guardian to execute approved bond not less than estimated personal estate and annual income and authorizes additional bond.

headings.title: Qualifications, certificates, and corporate surety rules for personal sureties
headings.reviewNote: Sets standards for two personal sureties, requires sworn property certificates, and authorizes court-ordered corporate surety.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.420 governing bond requirements and personal surety qualifications for veterans' guardians.

headings.title: Annual accounting requirement for moneys received from Veterans Administration
headings.reviewNote: Mandates filing sworn annual accounts detailing moneys, profits, disbursements, and invested balances from Veterans Administration.

headings.title: Exhibition and certification of securities and bank balances
headings.reviewNote: Requires guardian to exhibit securities to bank officer, surety representative, or judge and file duplicate certificates.

headings.title: Delivery of account copies and notice of hearing to Veterans Administration
headings.reviewNote: Directs transmission of certified accounts and pleadings to Veterans Administration and governs hearing notices and orders.

headings.title: Accounting for non-Veterans Administration property and combined accounts
headings.reviewNote: Applies general probate law to assets derived from other sources and permits filing combined accounts with veterans funds.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 editorial headings for 475.425 governing annual accounts, securities verification, and VA notice procedures.

headings.title: Court authorization to purchase home for ward or dependents
headings.reviewNote: Permits court to authorize purchase of fee simple home for ward or dependent family upon verified petition and hearing.

headings.title: Prerequisite evidence of value and vesting of title in ward
headings.reviewNote: Requires written appraisal and title evidence before approving purchase and mandates title be taken in ward's name.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.450 governing home purchases for wards under the Uniform Veterans' Guardianship Act.

headings.title: Commitment of eligible person to Veterans Administration or federal agency
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to commit eligible person to Veterans Administration or federal facility upon receipt of available bed certification.

headings.title: Interstate recognition of out-of-state federal commitment orders
headings.reviewNote: Gives commitment orders of other states committing persons to Veterans Administration same force and effect as Missouri orders.

headings.title: Transfer of hospitalized persons to Veterans Administration facilities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes hospital superintendents to transfer eligible patients to the Veterans Administration upon certification and court notice, barring transfer of persons confined for criminal convictions or acquitted solely for insanity without prior court order after motion and hearing.

headings.title: Status of transferred person under original commitment order
headings.reviewNote: Deems transferred persons committed to Veterans Administration pursuant to original judicial commitment order.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 editorial headings for 475.460 governing commitment of veterans to federal agencies and interstate recognition.

headings.title: Interstate communication between courts and party participation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Missouri courts to communicate with out-of-state courts regarding proceedings and allow party participation.

headings.title: Administrative communications without record-keeping requirement
headings.reviewNote: Permits courts to communicate concerning schedules, calendars, and administrative matters without making a formal record.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.504 governing interstate judicial communication and record-keeping rules under UAGPPJA.

headings.title: Requests by Missouri court for assistance from out-of-state courts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Missouri courts to request sister-state courts to conduct hearings, order evaluations, or preserve evidence.

headings.title: Limited jurisdiction to comply with out-of-state court requests
headings.reviewNote: Confers limited jurisdiction on Missouri courts to grant or make reasonable efforts to comply with subsection 1 assistance requests from out-of-state guardianship or protective proceeding courts.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.505 governing interstate judicial assistance and court cooperation.

headings.title: Deposition and testimony of out-of-state witnesses
headings.reviewNote: Permits testimony of out-of-state witnesses by deposition or other statutory evidentiary procedures.

headings.title: Remote testimony by telephone or audiovisual means
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes courts to allow witnesses located in another state to be deposed or testify by telephone or video conference.

headings.title: Admissibility of electronically transmitted documentary evidence
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits excluding documentary evidence transmitted from another state electronically solely for lack of original writing.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 3 editorial headings for 475.506 governing out-of-state witness depositions, remote testimony, and electronic evidence.

headings.title: Definitions for uniform adult guardianship jurisdiction provisions
headings.reviewNote: Defines emergency, home state, and significant-connection state for purposes of article 2 adult guardianship jurisdiction.

headings.title: Factors for determining significant connection with a state
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates statutory factors court must consider in determining whether respondent has significant connection to a state.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.521 establishing statutory definitions and significant connection factors under UAGPPJA.

headings.title: Special jurisdiction for emergency appointments and asset protection
headings.reviewNote: Grants special jurisdiction to appoint an emergency guardian for up to ninety days for a physically present respondent, issue protective orders for Missouri real or tangible personal property, or appoint a fiduciary after a sister-state provisional transfer order.

headings.title: Dismissal of emergency appointment upon home state proceeding
headings.reviewNote: Requires a non-home-state Missouri court to dismiss an emergency guardianship proceeding at the request of the home state court, whether requested before or after emergency appointment.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.524 governing special jurisdiction for emergency appointments and asset protection.

headings.title: Court authority to decline jurisdiction for inappropriate forum
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to decline jurisdiction if it determines a court of another state is a more appropriate forum.

headings.title: Dismissal or stay of proceedings upon declining jurisdiction
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court to dismiss or stay Missouri proceedings and impose conditions upon declining jurisdiction.

headings.title: Factors for determining appropriate forum between state courts
headings.reviewNote: Lists nine factors including respondent preference, abuse, neglect, or exploitation, duration of residence, distance, estate finances, evidence location, judicial efficiency, familiarity, and monitoring ability.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 3 editorial headings for 475.526 governing declination of jurisdiction in favor of more appropriate out-of-state forums.

headings.title: Declination of jurisdiction acquired through unjustifiable conduct
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court to decline jurisdiction, stay proceedings, or fashion remedies if jurisdiction was acquired through unjustifiable conduct.

headings.title: Assessment of expenses, attorney fees, and costs against engaging party
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes assessing necessary and reasonable expenses, attorney's fees, and costs against a party whose unjustifiable conduct created jurisdiction, while prohibiting assessments against the state or its subdivisions unless otherwise authorized by law.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.527 governing declination of jurisdiction and attorney fee sanctions for unjustifiable conduct.

headings.title: Petition by guardian or conservator to transfer proceeding out of state
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Missouri guardian or conservator to petition court to transfer proceeding to another state.

headings.title: Notice of transfer petition to interested persons
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice of transfer petition to all persons entitled to notice of an initial appointment proceeding.

headings.title: Hearing on petition to transfer proceeding
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court to hold hearing on transfer petition upon request of fiduciary, ward, protectee, or interested person.

headings.title: Provisional order granting transfer of guardianship
headings.reviewNote: Requires issuing a provisional guardianship transfer order if the other state will accept it, the ward is physically present or expected to move permanently there, no sustained objection exists, and care plans are reasonable and sufficient.

headings.title: Provisional order granting transfer of conservatorship
headings.reviewNote: Requires issuing a provisional conservatorship transfer order if the other state will accept it, the protectee is present, moving permanently, or has a significant connection there, no sustained objection exists, and adequate property management arrangements will be made.

headings.title: Final order confirming transfer and terminating proceeding
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of final order confirming transfer and terminating Missouri fiduciary authority upon foreign acceptance.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 6 editorial headings for 475.531 governing transfer of Missouri guardianships or conservatorships to another state.

headings.title: Petition to accept transfer of out-of-state guardianship or conservatorship
headings.reviewNote: Directs foreign guardian or conservator to petition Missouri court to accept transfer accompanied by certified provisional order.

headings.title: Notice of acceptance petition to interested persons
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice in Missouri's manner to all persons entitled to notice of an initial appointment petition in both the transferring state and Missouri.

headings.title: Hearing on petition to accept transferred proceeding
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to conduct hearing on transfer acceptance petition upon its own motion or request of interested persons.

headings.title: Provisional order accepting transfer of proceeding
headings.reviewNote: Requires issuing a provisional order accepting transfer unless an objector proves transfer is contrary to the person's interests or the guardian or conservator is ineligible for appointment in Missouri.

headings.title: Final order accepting transfer and appointing Missouri fiduciary
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of final order accepting proceeding and appointing fiduciary upon receipt of final foreign transfer order.

headings.title: Ninety-day review to conform fiduciary authority to Missouri law
headings.reviewNote: Mandates determination within ninety days of final order whether guardianship or conservatorship must be modified under Missouri law.

headings.title: Full faith and credit recognition of foreign adjudication determinations
headings.reviewNote: Requires court to recognize foreign appointment order and incapacity determinations when accepting transfer.

headings.title: Effect of denial on independent Missouri appointment petition
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that denial of transfer petition does not prejudice fiduciary's right to petition for independent Missouri appointment.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 8 editorial headings for 475.532 governing acceptance and confirmation of guardianships transferred from another state.

headings.title: Exercise of fiduciary powers under registered foreign protective order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes registered foreign guardian or conservator to exercise all authorized powers in Missouri consistent with state law.

headings.title: Judicial enforcement of registered out-of-state orders
headings.reviewNote: Empowers Missouri courts to grant any legal or equitable relief available under state law to enforce registered orders.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.543 governing the effect and enforcement of registered out-of-state protective orders.

headings.title: Prospective applicability to proceedings begun on or after August 28, 2011
headings.reviewNote: Applies uniform adult guardianship and protective proceedings jurisdiction act to proceedings initiated on or after August 28, 2011.

headings.title: Retroactive applicability of uniform communication and transfer provisions
headings.reviewNote: Applies interstate communication, cooperation, and transfer provisions to proceedings commenced prior to August 28, 2011.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 editorial headings for 475.555 governing effective date and retroactive applicability of UAGPPJA provisions.

headings.title: Parental delegation of child care powers to attorney-in-fact
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes delegating child care and custody powers to an attorney-in-fact for up to one year (excluding marriage, adoption, abortion, or parental rights termination), without modifying existing court orders or parental rights and obligations.

headings.title: Revocation and re-execution of power of attorney
headings.reviewNote: Preserves parent's right to revoke delegation at any time and requires annual re-execution for extended delegations.

headings.title: Continuous uncompensated exercise of authority by attorney-in-fact
headings.reviewNote: Directs the attorney-in-fact to exercise delegated authority continuously without compensation unless revoked, exempt from foster care home licensing or regulation statutes.

headings.title: Community service program assistance and permanent abandonment ban
headings.reviewNote: Permits crisis support programs to assist with delegation and prohibits using power of attorney to permanently abandon parental duty.

headings.title: Exemption from foster care status and licensing regulations
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that child under delegated power of attorney is not considered placed in foster care or subject to licensing rules.

headings.title: Mandatory background checks and child protection referrals by programs
headings.reviewNote: Requires crisis-support community programs to complete criminal, sex offender, and child abuse background checks for the attorney-in-fact and adult household members, bars placement with disqualified individuals, and mandates reporting suspected permanent avoidance to the children's division.

headings.title: Extended delegation authority for active duty military members
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes active-duty military, reserve, NOAA, detailed Public Health Service, and state active-duty parents or custodians to delegate powers for the term of active duty service plus thirty days.

headings.title: School attendance and preservation of school residency laws
headings.reviewNote: Requires attorney-in-fact to arrange school attendance and preserves public school residency requirements under section 167.020.

headings.title: Notice of power of attorney execution and revocation to schools
headings.reviewNote: Mandates notifying enrolled schools of power of attorney execution, dual communication during term, and termination notice.

headings.title: Preservation of child eligibility for existing public benefits
headings.reviewNote: Protects child's existing eligibility for free lunch, health care, and social service benefits during period of delegated power.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 10 editorial headings for 475.602 governing parental delegation of care powers to attorney-in-fact and community service safeguards.
